Q: ffmpeg encode timestamp on a timelapse video A:

I actually ran into the exact same problem before (real-time timestamps on timelapse), and most editors like Vegas/Premiere can’t really handle this properly.

I ended up building a small tool for this use case:
👉 https://github.com/nbjsnb/TimeOSD

What it does:

  • You set a start time + capture interval

  • It automatically maps each frame to real-world time

  • Generates subtitles (ASS) and lets you preview the result

  • Then you can either:

    • burn it into the video (FFmpeg), or

    • just mux it as a subtitle track (no re-encoding)

It’s basically designed for timelapse / action cam footage where the original timestamp is missing after stabilization.

Might be exactly what you’re looking for
